messages:
Alex Chen: Legal ping — they want exports that make it easy to answer \"who changed routing and why\". Specifically: include routing policy id, decision reason, and a human-friendly actor name. Need API shape + console preview UX. Any takers?
Maya Patel: I can sketch API. My proposal: NDJSON lines with minimal change envelope + routing block + actor hints. Also include a stable pseudonymous actor id for cross-export matching.
Ryan Gomez: Important: quota/size implications. Exporting full change history for big tenants hits our download quotas. We should surface estimated size in console and enforce export rate limits. Also presigned link TTL? Legal wants long-term access.
Maya Patel: sample NDJSON line I had in mind:
```json
{"ts":"1765504321","actor":{"id":"acct_789","display":"Maya Patel","pseudonym":"u_45"},"change":{"path":"/routing/policies/pp-12","op":"update","before":"{...}","after":"{...}"},"routing":{"policy_id":"rp-77","decision":"fallback_to_dedicated","reason":"capacity_pressure"}}
```
Samir Rao: That shape looks good. Two notes: 1) add an actor_resolution_hints array so console can show multiple candidate names if resolution is fuzzy; 2) include event_source (console/api) for telemetry.
Lee Wong: For console UX: show estimate (rows, bytes), a redact PII toggle (default on for enterprise), and a preview sample (first 10 lines). Make export a job with status + progress. Also expose a canary flag so we can rollout server-side.
Jordan Price: Redaction caveat: legal_hold customers may need unredacted exports. Need an entitlement check on request path and audit of who requested unredacted data. Also how do we log that request in the audit trail?
Ryan Gomez: Agreed. For presigned link TTL, proposal: default 72h for standard, 7d for enterprise with entitlement check. Also chunk large exports into 100MB parts to avoid single-link expiry/retry pain.
Maya Patel: Telemetry: export.* metrics we should emit: export.requested_by_tier, export.estimated_bytes, export.actual_bytes, export.rows, export.redaction_mode, export.pii_redacted_count. These feed billing and quota enforcement.
Samir Rao: API detail: POST /v1/audit/exports with body {scope: tenant|org, from_ts, to_ts, filters, routing_metadata: true|false, redact: strict|partial|none}. Response returns job id and estimated size.
Alex Chen: Question on routing metadata semantics — should we include the full policy snapshot or only the policy id + decision hint? Full snapshot balloons size.
Maya Patel: Prefer id + decision_hint + optional policy_snapshot_url (small) only when requested. Default: id + reason. If user wants policy content we provide on-demand link (subject to quota).
Lee Wong: Rollout plan: feature-flag endpoint + console toggle. 10% tenants first, monitor export.success_rate and export.latency and preview-sample-quality.
Jordan Price: Also need retention controls on exported artifacts in S3 and a clear deletion workflow. Legal might require preservation; ops needs retention TTL per tenant entitlement.
infra-bot: deploy to staging queued (PR #4721).
Alex Chen: Action items: Maya to draft API spec and NDJSON example; Samir to design entitlement checks + job API; Lee to mock console preview + estimate UX; Ryan to propose quota and presigned-link policy; Jordan to document redaction/legal hold edge cases. Will sync tomorrow 10am. Thanks. :thumbsup:
